# Stermont Arcade

> Online store in Kenya selling pest control and fumigation products, agrovet supplies, phones, TVs, appliances and home goods. Customers pay by M-Pesa and we deliver to all 47 counties. Shop: https://stermontarcade.co.ke/

## Key facts
- Location: The Sarit Centre, Karuna Road, Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya
- Phone / WhatsApp: +254 748 888 230
- Email: support@stermontarcade.co.ke
- Payment: M-Pesa. Currency: Kenya shillings (KES)
- Delivery: all 47 counties. Details: https://stermontarcade.co.ke/shipping.html
- Returns: https://stermontarcade.co.ke/returns.html
- Pest control and agrochemical products should carry a PCPB (Pest Control Products Board) registration number on the label
